findings.message: .ds/reviews/4ea83fe1fa66409c92a3c6ee02d10421ebad094c1225402771861e505b231dd7.defect.json differs from HEAD. ds ci reads only the committed copy: commit this one with the review.

The defect review failed. Fix what blocks it, then ask for a new review:
F1: The accepted sign-up message expands its grid track to the email address's min-content width. Submitting the local fixture with liisa.korhonen@suunnistusseurankilpailutoimikunta.example (57 characters, honeypot filled) makes the page 539 px wide at both 320 and 390 px with normal text, and 783 px wide with a 24 px default font, in FI/EN and light/dark. The address and following confirmation instruction run beyond the viewport. This fails WCAG 2.2 AA 1.4.10. Constrain the message grid children to the form width and let the dynamic email break anywhere; do not change the fixed consent text.
F2: On /tyot/ and /en/work/, Ratametsuri remains a plain heading with no product-page link; every walked product list has zero anchors to either new route. A visitor coming from the company's products cannot reach the new beta request page. D24 explicitly requires the product page to be linked from its products-list entry. Add a locale-correct internal link from that entry to /ratametsuri/ or /en/ratametsuri/.
F3: The visual gate has no baselines for either Ratametsuri route (16 missing-baseline errors), while the existing privacy baselines still show the shorter pre-Ratametsuri pages (16 size-changed errors). Capture the intended new product and privacy baselines and obtain reviewer approval of those exact files after the blocking UI defects are fixed. This failing review approves no replacements.
F4: Both product routes exceed the unchanged 2000 ms LCP budget: the median of three Lighthouse runs is 3002 ms for /ratametsuri/ (3002, 3002, 3003) and /en/ratametsuri/ (3002, 3004, 3002). Fix the loading/rendering delay and rerun the same module against the final build; a budget exception requires an explicit reason in kit.toml. The full Lighthouse reports are preserved in the evidence directory.
